descriptions.speaker: narrador
descriptions.description: A natural, expressive Latin American Spanish narrator. A mature male voice with a subtle Colombian accent, warm timbre and realistic human phrasing. This is a psychological horror story told to a friend late at night, not a news report or a commercial voiceover. Overall: historia de terror contada a un amigo en voz baja: arranca íntimo, la tensión sube línea a línea, el remate cae seco después de un silencio. Performance arc, sentence by sentence: 1) confidential, almost whispering a secret to a friend; 2) mysterious and intimate, low voice, slow pace, deliberate pauses, restrained tension; 3) suspenseful, holding the breath, tension rising toward the end of each sentence. Realistic human phrasing with natural pauses at ellipses and line breaks, varied pitch and pace, never monotone, never theatrical.

descriptions.speaker: abuela
descriptions.description: An elderly Colombian grandmother, around 80 years old, soft and slightly raspy voice, tender and calling gently from a dark hallway at night, slow and sweet, almost a whisper, which makes it unsettling. Overall: historia de terror contada a un amigo en voz baja: arranca íntimo, la tensión sube línea a línea, el remate cae seco después de un silencio. Performance: tender and soft, like talking to a child. Realistic human phrasing with natural pauses at ellipses and line breaks, varied pitch and pace, never monotone, never theatrical.

lines.text: Mi abuela tenía una sola regla en esa casa.
